gaps.sentence: I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.

gaps.sentence: He apologized for ___ so abrupt in the meeting.
This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.

gaps.sentence: They made me ___ for the whole team's mistake.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive in active sentences: made me apologise.
pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: I'd prefer ___ at home rather than go out.
gaps.explanation: would prefer + to-infinitive: I'd prefer to eat. (prefer + -ing for general likes.)

gaps.sentence: Despite ___ three times, he didn't give up.
